title: My Birthday Yesterday
gist_ar: بنت بتحكي عن عيد ميلادها امبارح.

before_listening.en: Someone talks about yesterday. Listen for what the day WAS.
before_listening.ar: حد بيتكلم عن امبارح. ركّز على اليوم كان إيه.

segments.speaker: Nour
segments.text: Yesterday was my birthday. I was very happy. My family was at home with me. My mother was in the kitchen all morning. There was a big cake on the table. It was chocolate. My friends were here at six o'clock. We were together for three hours. There were ten people in my small flat! My little brother was very excited. It was a good day. Today I am tired, but I am happy.

questions.q: What kind of cake was on the table?
questions.q_ar: الكيكة اللي على الترابيزة كانت إيه؟
